title: GPU MODE Challenge 08: 2-D convolution (fp32; 256x256, K=32, 128 channels, batch 1 scored)

workload.description: Y = conv2d(X, W), no padding, stride 1, fp32, checked at rtol = atol = 1e-3 against cuDNN with TF32 disabled.  task.yml lists 5 benchmarks; kernelbot ranks by RankCriterion.LAST, so the score is the LAST case only: size 256, kernelsize 32, channels 128, batch 1 (seed 6252) -- 225x225x128 outputs, each a 131,072-term dot product: 1.699 TFLOP as a direct convolution.
